changes.name: SkyPowerShrine
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local shrine=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("GrasslandsDecor"):WaitForChild("CentralShrineCrystal")
local prompt=shrine:WaitForChild("UpgradePrompt")
local levels={0,1,2,3,5}
local costs={0,5000000,25000000,100000000,500000000}
local function update(player)
 local level=player:GetAttribute("SkyPowerLevel") or 0
 if level>=4 then prompt.ActionText="MAX LEVEL";prompt.ObjectText="SKY POWER x5";return end
 prompt.ActionText="UPGRADE - "..costs[level+2].." COINS"
 prompt.ObjectText="SKY POWER x"..levels[level+1].." → x"..levels[level+2]
end
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
 local level=player:GetAttribute("SkyPowerLevel") or 0
 if level>=4 then return end
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");local coins=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
 local cost=costs[level+2]
 if not coins or coins.Value<cost then return end
 coins.Value-=cost
 player:SetAttribute("SkyPowerLevel",level+1)
 update(player)
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) p:SetAttribute("SkyPowerLevel",0) end)
